title: Late Cashback Payment Make-Good on the Everyday Pay Card, Cartwise Shopper Payouts
content:
# Cartwise Shopper Payouts: make-good when a cashback payment is long past

Where a long time has gone by since an Everyday Pay Card account last received a cashback payment, the next statement payment carries a late make-good.

**Rule.** A late make-good is added outside the cap when the previous cashback payment is long past, the days being counted from the account's opening date when it has no earlier cashback payment. Where the latest earlier cashback payment was made 45 or more days before and the shopper is at Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond level, the make-good is 5 percent of the capped payment, rounded to the cent. Where it was made 45 or more days before and the shopper is below Full-Service Shopper Platinum level, the make-good is a fixed 2.00. Otherwise there is no make-good.

Shopper levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond, and a level named with "or above" or "or below" is read in that order.

## Judgement table

| Days since the latest earlier cashback payment (or since opening, when there is none) | Shopper level | Make-good |
|---|---|---|
| 45 or more | Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 5 percent of the capped payment, rounded to the cent |
| 45 or more | Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver or Full-Service Shopper Gold | 2.00 |
| 44 or fewer | any level | none |

## Points of judgement

- The count starts from the date of the latest cashback payment booked on the account before this one; an account that has never received a cashback payment counts from its opening date.
- 45 days exactly qualifies; 44 days does not.
- The percentage acts on the capped payment, the amount after the cap, and the make-good itself sits outside the cap.
- The shopper level is the one shown on the shopper's contractor account on the day of the payment.

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- Platinum shopper, last cashback payment 50 days ago, capped payment 36.30: make-good 5 percent of 36.30, which is 1.815, rounded to 1.82.
- Silver shopper, account opened 60 days ago with no cashback payment yet: make-good 2.00.
- Diamond shopper, last cashback payment 44 days ago: no make-good.
